notes.title: Patch 1.0.5.1 - Major Menu UI Overhaul, Refactored Code, Server Browser, & More
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 1.0.5.1 - Major Menu UI Overhaul, Refactored Code, Server Browser, & More![/h1]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090012/0cd56a0cf79df73ad9bfd062b5348f73f6a86e77.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Menu UI[/h2]
The main menu UI has gotten a major overhaul! We’ve modernized the main menu in a way that we think you’ll absolutely love. Gone are the days of the dark, gloomy locker room. The new UI  brings a few new features with it, including a server browser and global chat but more on that later. We also have some even more exciting features coming to the menu UI in the future. Here are some screenshots, but we highly suggest loading up Gridiron and taking a look around! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090012/dd9e731c51488be5d3aa8be4feaec664386938f4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090012/20c79cd01a838e261226bd27fce3b5f9fd618994.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090012/10eb14928a7a562e22d1373efcd2abfd6dc93722.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090012/24413a432fc8e585f42df4312f31efc5493d9781.jpg[/img]

[h2]Refactored Gridiron Code[/h2]
The foundational code that Gridiron was built on has been refactored from Unreal Blueprints to C++. While you may not immediately notice the effects of the refactor, this has massive implications for the state of the game now and in the future. Gridiron’s code has been cleaned up and made more efficient, which will make fixing bugs and adding features faster and more seamless. This is a major step forward for the game and our vision of a polished Gridiron. 

[h2]Server Browser[/h2]
We want our players to be able to play Gridiron however they want. To facilitate that process, we have added a server browser to Gridiron! Players can create lobbies with custom settings and open them up to the public. After you host a lobby for the gamemode of your choice you can then advertise it in the new Global Chat! Players searching for games in the server browser can also filter results by name and gamemode. It’s easier than ever to find players to play Gridiron with!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4.47 - The Visual Routes Update
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 1.0.4.47[/h1]


[h2]Visual Routes System[/h2]
Gridiron now has a visual routes/play art system! Quarterbacks now have new formations to choose from in the huddle. There are a number of plays with predetermined route/run concepts. Once the quarterback picks a play, players can see their assignment on the field itself!
[list]
[*] Receivers can see their routes on the field.
[*] Runningbacks can see their routes, blocking assignment, or intended running scheme for handoffs. 
[*] Linemen can see an indication that they’re supposed to block on offense or rush the passer on defense. 
[*] Corners and safeties can see the zone they are responsible for covering, the player they are supposed to guard in man coverage, or even where they’re supposed to rush on blitz plays.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090012/6b5a964058b68e980b628e8b5c34af44a149bcc2.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090012/af17f79b7ccb42e5e9fea9dd452902f2296002e3.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Ping System[/h2]
The new Ping System will make communicating with your teammates easier than ever during plays. Prior to this update, it was basically impossible for players to communicate with their team during a play without a mic.
[list]
[*] Players can use the ping hotkey to bring up a menu that will display several communication options based on their position.
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Introduced a mechanic designed to punish QBs when they drop back very far behind the line of scrimmage. Once the QB reaches 14 yards behind the line of scrimmage they will get progressively slower for the next 6 yards they back up until they are slowed the most possible at 20 yards behind the line of scrimmage. 
[*] Moved the hash marks on the field closer together. 
[/list]

[h2]Matchmaking Changes[/h2]
We’ve removed the match acceptance feature along with the ability to queue for multiple game modes at once. Limitations with our matchmaking service prevented us from getting the acceptance feature to work as we intended.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

notes.title: The MEGALODON Update: New Stadium, New Blocking System, Major Gameplay Changes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090012/e72ac8598ee4d8bbeb079f639780330c046e35f9.png[/img]

[h1]Patch 1.0.4.29 - The MEGALODON Update[/h1]

We are excited to introduce the MEGALODON Update! This is the largest and quite possibly best Gridiron update we’ve ever released. Packed with features and gameplay changes, we hope you all enjoy playing it as much as we’ve enjoyed making it!

[h2]Blocking 3.0[/h2]
Blocking 2.0 fell short of our expectations. We've been in the lab grinding on the latest version of the shields and we’re excited to show them to you! 

[h3]Shield Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The shield now drains shield stamina when holding it out and not blocking anybody.
[*] The shield stops draining stamina when you make contact with a defensive player, or put it away, in which case it will start regenerating.
[*] The shield now only slows players when they physically contact the front of the shield.
[*] The shield can no longer be abused or glitched via jumping when you make contact with it.
[*] Blocking in the back is no longer possible.
[*] The shield now has a concave hitbox to better hold players.
[*] You can now dive and dashe off of shields horizontally.
[/list]


[h3]Bash Blocking[/h3]
With Shields 3.0, linemen can now bash players that are contacting your shield and send them back a short distance, creating room and relieving pressure on your QB.
[list]
[*] Bash can be bound to any key you like but is set to RMB by default.
[*] Bash is tied to your shield stamina. Executing one bash costs 40 shield stamina. You have a total of 100 shield stamina that regenerates over time.
[*] After 2 seconds of holding up the shield, the shield will enter a charged state, and upon successfully bashing a player with a charged shield, will slow the player hit by by 15% for 2 seconds.
[/list]

[h3]Pancake Blocking[/h3]
With the introduction of the bash mechanic, you can also now pancake defensive players trying to get to your quarterback! 
[list]
[*] The pancake block will send the player hit by it back a few yards, and knock them to the ground for up to 1.5 seconds depending on the distance travelled while dashing. 
[*] To execute a pancake block, you must dash into a player with your shield up and use your bash as your shield makes contact with them. 
[*] The player you intend to bash must be in a "Vulnerable" Status(Indicated by a yellow bleeding eye above their head) which can be applied via a bash from yourself or another linemen.
[/list]

[h3]Defensive Line Spin Move[/h3]
We also are introducing a spin move for defensive linemen! A clever new mechanic that can be used masterfully to get off of shields and to make great plays.
[list]
[*] The spin move costs 15 stamina to use and spins the player to the left or the right(Q and E by default) a short distance.
[*] The spin move can be used most effectively to get off the edge of a shield that is blocking you, or to bait out a pancake block.
[*] Using the spin move as a offensive linemen tries to pancake you and forcing them to miss will award you with a free dash(your next dash executed within 4 seconds will cost 0 stamina)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090012/7a669df50ecbbd2345b50307eb4214124c84f5b8.png[/img]
[h2]The Underwater Stadium[/h2]
Humans have returned to Kepler-1989g aka Styx, the home planet of the Scyllians. The Purpose? Some good old-fashioned diplomatic football. Humanity is in for a tough away game though, as the home team and their fans may not be too fond of them...

This exoplanet whose surface is 92.43% covered in water is home to the brand new underwater Gridiron stadium. Check out the reveal trailer to see the stadium in all its glory!

Players can now select which stadium they’d like to play in in custom games. The Underwater Stadium will also appear more often in public matches for a limited time!

[h2]Competitive Ruleset Changes for Runningbacks and Linemen[/h2]
We want competitive games to feel more competitive, so a few changes are coming to the runningback and offensive line positions in ranked and custom matches with the competitive ruleset enabled.
[list]
[*] Linemen in the competitive ruleset will now receive permanent ineligibility if they activate their shield. This does not apply to runningbacks, quarterbacks, or wide receivers.
[*] The Runningback will no longer make a loud sound when receiving a handoff.
[*] These changes do not apply to other positions and are only applicable during a normal play(Kickoffs and Punts will have normal rules.
[/list]


[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the ability for players to name their team and set a team abbreviation in custom lobbies. Your team name and abbreviation will appear during gameplay!
[*] Ball Carrier Stamina Drain is now 1.65x greater then the default stamina drain instead of 1.75x greater.
[*] Players can now close some UI elements by pressing the escape key, including the in-game chat prompt. 
[*] Changed how the camera behaves when a player is tackled. 
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the tackle hitboxes were not behaving correctly and allowed for tackles to happen when the tackler was not close enough to the ball carrier. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the down and distance would be incorrect after a team intercepts the ball.
[*] Fixed an issue where the tutorial prompts would appear over the options menu. 
[*] Fixed an issue where changing your FOV in the main menu would cause issues with the character being displayed in the locker room.
[*] Accepting a game invitation before opening Gridiron will now put you in the lobby with the player who invited you instead of just opening the game. 
[*] Fixed an issue where spectators could not see the touchdown and conversion graphics after a team scores. 
[*] Fixed an issue where a player would start the next play from the spot they were tackled instead of their appropriate spot in the formation.
[/list]

[h2]Status Effects[/h2]
This patch introduces several status effects as described above. These are the icons of the different status effects that you can receive and what they mean:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090012/3acae27a303ff891a6a5d480e2dfeaeaa7416ddf.png[/img]
[b]Vulnerable[/b]: Lasts 2.0 seconds - This debuff is applied when an offensive lineman bashes a defender. Players with the Vulnerable status effect can be pancake blocked. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090012/93e2c5cf736aea7ab264dd6b8ca5fe7fff5e4976.png[/img]
[b]Shield Charge[/b]: 2.0 second charge up period - When a shield is charged, you can discharge it by bashing a defensive player, giving them the Slowed status effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090012/b4dd3c47e7da46a97c6252900562bf8feb580c8a.png[/img]
[b]Slowed[/b]: Lasts 2.0 seconds - Applied by a charged shield bashing into a defensive player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090012/dcb4a16877fd683d1aeb4266309e1329535d9bfc.png[/img]
[b]Rocket Boots[/b]: Lasts 0.5 seconds - Increases player speed by 25% after successfully bashing a defender.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090012/b30da35753a328fa0056a97665bb6879772c4852.png[/img]
[b]Pancaked![/b]: - Lasts 0.75 seconds - You've been knocked to the ground by a charging offensive lineman. You can get back up after the duration expires!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090012/89fd92ab8abb4b100eced17814b3d8ed0a4dfb30.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4.28 - Major Sound Overhaul, New Scoreboard, & More
notes.content:
[h2]Patch 1.0.4.28[/h2]

[h2]Advanced Sound System[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gridiron sounds better than ever! We did a major overhaul of the sound system.
[*] Reactive crowd sounds. The crowd will now cheer, boo, & more based on the action on-field.
[*] Added new tackle sounds for Humans, Aqua, and Synths.
[*] More tackling impact sounds.
[*] High velocity tackle sounds for the Synth.
[*] New sounds for the Hex and Digi shields.
[*] Two new Touchdown Celebration tracks.
[*] New half-time horn.
[*] Added a sound for each bounce that the ball takes in Chaosball.
[*] Added a unique sound for interceptions.
[*] Rebalanced many sounds to be heard more clearly in certain situations.
[/list]

[h2]New Scoreboard[/h2]
The in-game scoreboard has been overhauled. The new scoreboard is a lot cleaner and shows some stats differently. For example, completions are now shown on the scoreboard instead of just the completion percentage. So instead of showing 75%, it will say that the QB has completed 3/4 passes.

NOTE: If you cannot open the in-game scoreboard, rebind the tab menu in your options.

[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed the 4 player party limit for Casual matches. Players can now queue for Casual matches in a party of up to 7.
[*] Players can now vote to switch the QB once after halftime in Casual and Ranked mode.
[/list]


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with voice chat.
[*] Fixed an issue where players who were backfilled and standing on the sideline could catch the ball.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.3.49 - The Blocking Update
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 1.0.3.49[/h1]

[h2]The Blocking System Rework[/h2]
Football is a game that is won and lost in the trenches. A consistent offensive line is key to any offense producing results. Gridiron is no different.

When players reached out to us and provided us with feedback saying that our shields were making it impossible to play consistently, we began work on a system that would provide consistent results while still feeling rewarding for players. 

The new blocking system takes the parts of the old system that you have come to know & love and combines them with some new features to provide more consistent and readable line play.
[list]
[*]Blocking is now consistent and reliable. If you hit an oncoming player with your shield, they will be blocked. Exploits from the old system such as jailing and hooking are no longer possible.
[*]The shield now has its own energy separate from stamina. 
[*]Holding the block until the shield breaks causes both players to be pushed away from each other.
[*]Offensive linemen can slightly push defensive linemen if they land a precise block with the center of their shield. Defensive linemen can slightly push offensive linemen if the offensive lineman lands a block with the edges of their shield.
[*]A distinct sound notification will now alert all players if a block has been broken.
[*]If you are mid-slide or mid-dive and you get hit by a shield, your slide or dive will be stopped at the location the shield made contact, resulting in a successful block.
[*]Players can only land a block on one other player at a time. 
[*]Blocking from behind is no longer possible. Players can no longer land a block on a player who is running away from them. Note that you can still block players who are walking towards you with their back turned. 
[/list]

[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Removed the ability to gain momentum by slide-jumping. Jumping while sliding will now end your slide. 
[*]Slightly extended the distance of the dive.
[*]Improved some audio features of the Moon Stadium.
[*]Added a kick sound for when players kick the ball.
[/list]

[list]

[/list]

[h3]Patch 1.0.3.23[/h3]

The community asked, and we answered. We know a lot of you have wanted to be able to earn some of the sweet skins and characters outside of custom events, and now you can. Starting this patch, playing matchmaking games of GridIron earns you Gridollars, which can be spent in our store to buy custom skins and characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090012/7e044dc2441b6e4f77f9e420c73659f748b95571.png[/img]

During this initial patch, we will be soft launching with the Synth character, and his limited edition Synthetic Gold skin. [h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved settings for streamers, including stream snipe prevention and chat hiding.
[*]Added a new trackable stat, Tackle for Loss.
[*]Added the ability to visit a players steam profile directly from the scoreboard.
[*]Stats will no longer be recorded on 2 point conversions(except for the actual conversion stat)
[*]Removed the bunny hop protection jump restriction. Now you can jump twice without any impact to movement or stamina. The third/fourth/fifth jumps however will begin taking more and more stamina. This only counts for jumps in quick succession.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with Voice communications sometimes not working when backfilled into a game.
[*]Added an additional color to the player ring to indicate ball possession,
[*]Fixed an issue where the ball was able to collide with the players camera when being held.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3.20
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 1.0.3.20[/h1]
Patch 1.0.3.20 introduces the new behavior system, new visual stances, and important balance changes that help the game feel more dynamic and rewarding.

[h2]New Behavior System[/h2]
We've added in a completely new report system. Starting with this patch, reporting players now carries penalties from voice and text communication mutes to matchmaking cooldowns and game bans. 
If you see someone being toxic, please report them so we can keep improving our community!

[h2]Stance System[/h2]
We are introducing stances to the game. At the beginning of each play, you will assume a stance based on the position you are playing.
[list]
[*]Offensive Linemen will take up a 3 point stance.
[*]Defensive Linemen will take up a 4 point stance.
[*]Wide Receivers will take up a 2 point stance.
[*]Defensive secondary players will take up a 2 point stance unless they are playing on the line.
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Shields no longer block your own teammates.
[*]Added a little bit of control to your character while in the air.
[*]Added the ability to jump out of a slide resulting in a carry of horizontal momentum into the jump.
[*]Added the ability to dive out of a slide.
[*]Reduced the distance of a dive.
[*]Increased the speed of diving.
[*]Dive no longer uses or requires stamina.
[*]Removed the ability for Defensive linemen to free roam on defense. The secondary is still allowed to free roam when that option is enabled.
[*]Added ineligible receivers to the competitive custom match ruleset.
[/list]

[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a mercy rule that prevents the clock from stopping if the game is in a blowout.
[*]Moved the goal post back further so that players cant collide with it during play.
[*]Added a whistle at the end of each play.
[*]Added persistence to the chat channel you were last using.
[*]Disabled the AFK timer if the game is paused.
[*]Added the ability to change quarter length in custom matches.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fix a bug causing extra plays to run after the clock has reached 0:00
[*]Fixed a bug where a punting team touches the ball they punted in the end zone and forces the other team to start the next play inside the end zone.
[*]Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause the ball to curve after it was thrown.
[*]Fixed incorrect spelling of Offense in the scoreboard.
[*]Fixed a bug where the clock was not stopping on change of possession.
[*]Fixed a bug causing a change of possession on third down when the quarter changes.
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed a team to call a timeout at the end of the half time and gave the offense the ball for an offensive play instead of kicking off.
[/list]

With those changes, we are going to reset all stats and migrate over to the new Early Access Season 2 model.

Starting in Season 2, Players will now gain rank based on their stats for each role. The roles are QB, Receiver, and Lineman. 

Quarterback Ranking will be influenced by your yards passing, your passing touchdowns, and your pass completions.

Receiver Ranking takes into account your reception yards, your reception touchdowns, and your interceptions to award outstanding defensive play.

Lineman Ranking will look at your blocks, sacks, and tackles to award playing both sides of the ball well.

[list]
[*] Quarterbacks can now sprint and jump while in first or third person.
[*] You can now choose your preference for either first or third person in the options menu.
[*] Quarterbacks can no longer slide or dive while in throwing mode.
[*] Football now moves with 15% more velocity.
[*] Quarterbacks can now throw the ball 10 yards further then before.

Casual Matches are now giving you a hidden rating (MMR) which will determine your skill level and learn as you play more games. notes.title: Major Updates and New Content
notes.content:
Hey Gridiron!

It’s been a week since we first released Gridiron as an early-access title to all of you, and what a week it’s been! We’ve been overwhelmed by the huge support and amazing feedback every one of you has shown in the past week.

The entire team has been stunned by your creativeness and how quickly some players have become very skilled in the game.

This week we’ve released an update every day, tackling some serious bugs and implementing some of your suggestions. Here’s a quick overview of the most serious bugs we’ve resolved:

[list]
[*] Slowed down the ball velocity
[*] Added ability to mute players
[*] Moved away from Captain’s Pick to randomised teams
[*] Fixed a lot of crashes
[*] Fixed some cases where servers would have imbalanced teams
[/list]

We still have plenty of bugs to resolve, which is only possible through the feedback everyone has been giving.

Our team has also been making progress towards releasing some new features, which include:

[list]
[*] Ability to create a custom/private match, which players can use to set up any custom scenario they want, including the ability to scrim other teams.
[*] Adding more cosmetic items to the game. This includes ball trails and new characters.
[*] Introducing a new stadium
[/list]

Once again, thank you everyone for being so supportive. Please continue to share your experience with us, it really is the fuel behind our team’s motivation.

1336Studios Team

We've released another bug fix update for everyone.

[list]
[*] Several fixes to punts and field goals.
[*] Added a profanity filter to the game chat.
[*] Quitting the game or disconnecting will prompt a message.
[*] Players that quit a game early will have their stats sent and in some cases result in a loss.
[*] Crash fixes to make the game more stable.
[*] Player login out during kicking of ball now doesn't end the play.
[*] No more dive+slide.
[*] Training mode now shows stamina bar
[*] Classic ball doesn't go below the field on snap.
[*] Removed 4v4 UI and players connected/games played
[*] Removed weird effect in some instances where the ball flied away after colliding with a close player
[/list]

Hello Guys and Gals,

We've released another bug fix update for Gridiron.

[list]
[*] Fixed issue that caused backfill players to only be humans
[*] End game ost added
[*] Now you can see who is talking on voice chat, including yourself
[*] Fixed issue that caused server to crash on 4th down
[*] Fixed issue that caused out of bounds on 4th down to give an extra down on turnover
[*] Removed onside kicks entirely
[*] Muting in voice chat also mutes in text chat
[*] Issue in which players where being switched to the wrong team fixed
[*] Fixed replication on things like nameplates
[/list]

This update was delayed due to some other bugs cropping up during our testing. We plan to release more updates this week with further bug fixes. Thank you everyone for the amazing feedback we've received!

- Players will be matched into games with more balanced team sizes. This should fix situations where you would get 7 vs 1 in a match.
- Removed duplicate message "your captain is picking a play" from UI.
- Text should display white instead of black now in chat.
- Fixed issue with captain pick UI that displayed incorrect win percentage.

We are continuing to work through the bugs and plan to release another update later today.
